title: Discernment of Spirits
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Discernment of spirits is the Scripture-shaped ability to test spiritual claims, teachings, influences, and experiences to determine whether they are from God. True discernment is humble, biblical, and Christ-centered.
summary: Discernment of spirits is the Scripture-shaped ability to test spiritual claims, teachings, influences, and experiences to determine whether they are from God. True discernment is humble, biblical, and Christ-centered.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the standard of spiritual truth. Every spirit, teaching, and claim must be tested by what it says about Him and whether it agrees with the Gospel revealed in Scripture.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture commands believers not to believe every spirit. Spiritual claims must be tested because deception can sound religious, powerful, emotional, or convincing.

Discernment is not the same as suspicion, cynicism, or spiritual pride. It is a humble commitment to truth under God’s Word. The test is not popularity or intensity, but faithfulness to Christ and Scripture.

Some believers may be especially gifted in discernment, but all believers are called to grow in maturity and test what they hear. God’s people must distinguish good from evil through practice in the Word.

True discernment leads to faithfulness, not fear. It protects devotion to Christ, guards the church, and helps believers reject what is false while holding fast to what is good.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People can be deceived by spiritual language, supernatural claims, emotional experiences, or trusted personalities. Without discernment, the vulnerable may be led away from Christ.

This doctrine encourages believers to test carefully without becoming harsh. The goal is not to win arguments, but to remain faithful to Jesus and protect souls.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Test spiritual claims by Scripture and the confession of Christ. Ask whether a teaching agrees with the Gospel, honors Jesus as Lord, produces holiness, and submits to God’s Word. Seek discernment with humility, prayer, and love for truth.
